summary: January series expiry review: worst month in years. Divergent stock-specific results (IT, banking, autos). FII January cash selling ~86000 crore; mid/small caps -15-20% in a month. Budget framed as last chance; speaker shows bullish pre-budget option strategies (Nirmala Candle 2.0 bet).

events.claim: FIIs sold ~86000 crore in Indian cash market during January 2025 (speaker cites ~5000 crore on 30 Jan)
Midcap and smallcap mutual funds/funds lost 15-20% of value in January 2025
Tata Motors fell ~7% on Q3 results on 30 Jan 2025
September 2019 corporate tax cut triggered ~5% Nifty rally (Nirmala candle 1.0)

lessons: Budget was framed as the government's last chance to revive market sentiment; without stock-market-friendly measures the underperformance persists.
quote: Budget is the last chance to revive the sentiment of the market.

summary: Budget-eve setup: US near ATH despite DeepSeek tech selloff; ECB on hold; India lagging badly (Nifty -10-12%, mid/small -15-20%). FII index-futures shorts eased 89% to 75%; record index-futures OI suggests violent move, skewed upward. Suggests Bank Nifty vs Nifty pair trade.

events.claim: US S&P 500 near all-time high on 31 Jan 2025 despite DeepSeek-related tech selloff
European Central Bank held rates at its late-January 2025 meeting; Euro Stoxx at fresh ATH
FII index-futures short position ~89% earlier in January 2025, eased to ~75% by month-end (speaker estimate)
Record open interest in index futures ahead of Feb 2025 budget/RBI events

lessons: Hedged futures positioning at record OI after heavy downside tends to resolve violently; after a 10-12% fall the upward tail is larger.
quote: Never short this market before the event; if you want to short, do it after.

summary: First session of February series strong: Nifty closes decisively above 23500 first time since 13 Jan breakdown. Maps structure: 26300 ATH, Nov-2024 closing low ~23350, 50% retracement ~1500 pts. FII futures shorts at 89% historically precede recoveries; expects Nirmala Candle 2.0 on good budget.

events.claim: Nifty closed above 23500 on 31 Jan 2025 for the first time since breaking below it on 13 Jan 2025
Nifty post-election swing/closing low around 23350 on 21 Nov 2024 (intraday ~23263)
FII index-futures short share hit ~89% in Jan 2025, historically the highest and followed by recoveries (speaker)
September 2019: corporate tax cut 30% to 22% produced a ~5% Nifty rally

lessons: First trading session of a new series sets the series tone in bull phases; markets rarely revisit the first session low.
quote: Hope is the worst enemy in the stock market, but we have no other word to use.

summary: Budget 2025 reaction: disappointment for markets. Sole big positive: no income tax up to 12 lakh (new regime), but capital-gains earners get only 4 lakh rebate. Bank Nifty crossed 50000 intraday on hopes, then faded. VIX/premiums crushed. Speaker's bullish option bets survived via sold puts.

events.claim: Union Budget 2025-26 (1 Feb 2025): no income tax up to 12 lakh income (new regime); no relief on STT/LTCG/STCG for markets
87A rebate limits capital-gains earners to ~4 lakh effective exemption instead of 12 lakh
Bank Nifty crossed 50000 intraday on 31 Jan/1 Feb 2025 budget optimism
India VIX/option premiums collapsed sharply after the budget

lessons: Do not copy a capital-rich seller's bullish structure as an option buyer; equal capability is required (bus-and-pothole analogy).
quote: If you want to follow somebody, you must have the equal capability.

summary: Trump tariffs on Mexico/Canada/China announced; Canada retaliates 25%. GIFT Nifty -200 pts, wiping the pre-budget rally. Budget judged negative for markets (no STT/tax relief). Key risk: retail SIP faith breaking would remove DII support. Range 23000-24000 with 22800/23800 pivots.

events.claim: Trump announced 25% tariffs on Canada and Mexico and 10% on China (31 Jan/1 Feb 2025); US market fell 1-2%
Canada announced retaliatory 25% tariffs on US goods
FIIs sold on budget-day Saturday session (1 Feb 2025), signaling zero rating for the budget (speaker)

lessons: Market structure holds while retail SIP money keeps flowing; redemption reversal is the cascade trigger to watch.
quote: FIIs need a shock therapy; small good things only become exit opportunities.

summary: US recovery on Mexico tariff postponement; yields ease. Aggressive 23500 call writing into a gap-up risks short-covering squeeze. Mid/small caps still under pressure (BPCL ~30-35% off ATH). Advises longs only above 23900; expects 2025 large-cap over mid/small-cap.

events.claim: Trump postponed Mexico tariffs by one month after talks (3 Feb 2025); Mexico did not retaliate
BPCL trading ~245 vs all-time high ~370, i.e. ~30-35% below peak (Feb 2025)

lessons: Gap-ups in a downtrend are usually sold; judge the close, not the open (amateurs open, professionals close).
quote: Amateurs open the market and professionals close the market.

summary: FII pause for one day triggers violent reversal: Nifty +~400, Bank Nifty +~1000. Bizarre premium behavior - puts doubled while market rose. ITM calls traded at 45-50 discount to intrinsic; speaker arbitraged them. Draws 2013 parallel (rupee low, FII selling, LIC entry bottom).

events.claim: On 4 Feb 2025 Nifty rose ~400 points and Bank Nifty ~1000 as FII selling paused for a day
China announced retaliatory measures against US tariffs on 4 Feb 2025, denting US futures
2013: rupee at all-time low with heavy FII selling; a one-day LIC entry marked the market bottom (speaker account)

lessons: ITM options trading below intrinsic value signal forced liquidation and can be arbitraged, but size remains small for buyers.
quote: Operation successful, patient died - I was bullish, bought calls, and the market fell.

summary: Nifty dips ~40 as FMCG (HUL/ITC/Asian Paints/Titan results) drags; Bank Nifty strong on rate-cut hope (25bp expected 7 Feb). Budget raised STT collection target - read as confidence. Market-linked stocks surge (Nippon AMC +8%, CAMS, KFin). FIIs sell ~1700 crore.

events.claim: RBI expected to cut repo rate 25bp on 7 Feb 2025, first cut in ~5 years
Budget 2025 raised the government's STT collection target significantly
Nippon India AMC rose 8%+ with CAMS and KFin on market-revival expectations (5 Feb 2025)
Google (Alphabet) shares fell 7-9% on weak results; Apple fell 3% on China antitrust probe (early Feb 2025)

lessons: Government raising STT collection targets signals official confidence that market activity will stay healthy.
quote: Every small good thing becomes an exit opportunity for FIIs.

summary: RBI policy-eve: expects 25bp cut, possible CRR cut, and dovish first commentary from new governor. Both Nifty and Bank Nifty technically long. 23500-24000 expected consolidation; calendar-spread margin benefit removal noted. Speaker doing audio from Dubai trip (leak).

events.claim: RBI February 2025 policy is the first under new governor Sanjay Malhotra; market expects 25bp cut and CRR cut
SEBI removed calendar-spread margin benefit effective ~end Feb 2025 (deadline cited as Feb 25)

lessons: Event windows (budget/RBI) concentrate premium; calendar spreads monetize event-date premium without direction risk.
quote: Expect the unexpected when the RBI governor speaks for the first time.
leaks: audio from Dubai trip - residence/travel leak

summary: Total disappointment pre-RBI: Nifty -150 in first hour, closed ~-40; Bank Nifty outperformed (catch-up). Results after hours (ITC, Hero MotoCorp, M&M, Bharti Airtel) weight sentiment. BoE cut to UK ATH vs India struggling at rupee record low. Clarifies time-correction vs price-correction framework.

events.claim: Bank of England cut rates on 6 Feb 2025; UK market hit fresh all-time high
Rupee at record low vs USD in early Feb 2025
Swiggy fell below its IPO price within ~3 months of listing (Feb 2025)
Delhi assembly elections scheduled 5 Feb 2025 (results 8 Feb); speaker calls them market-irrelevant

lessons: Distinguish price correction from time correction: a market can drift sideways for years without deep drawdowns.
quote: Bullish or bearish depends on the time frame; short term can differ from years.

summary: RBI policy day setup: everything hinges on the outcome. S&P 500 boxed 5800-6150 for months; India range 23000-24000 but at the wrong end. Results after hours (Bharti, ITC, Hero MotoCorp). Notes 1000-point month-swing has become the new normal.

events.claim: S&P 500 consolidated between ~5800 and ~6150 from Dec 2024 to Feb 2025

lessons: Event-day direction comes from the policy, not the gap: position for range, not prediction.
quote: 1000-point falls and rallies in a month have become very normal.
leaks: planned webinar with a leading media house

summary: Friday US selloff on weekend tariff fear; Trump floats 25% steel/aluminum tariffs (commodity-specific). Delhi election (BJP win) judged market-irrelevant - only UP, Gujarat and pre-parliament five-state polls matter. Both FII and DII activity thin; events now over, market must pick a direction.

events.claim: Trump announced 25% tariffs on steel and aluminium (~9-10 Feb 2025)
Delhi assembly election results 8 Feb 2025: BJP won a comfortable majority

lessons: Only politically consequential state elections (UP, Gujarat, pre-parliament five states) move markets; others are noise.
quote: What budget could not do and RBI could not do, how can a Delhi election do it?

summary: Rupee gaps to record low at open (~88 cited; likely ~86.7) - double loss for FIIs (stocks + currency). Nifty holds 50% Fib (~23300) of the pre-budget 1000-pt rally; mid/small caps -2%+. Aggressive call writing 23400-24000; VIX rising on red days signals more downside.

events.claim: Rupee hit all-time low vs USD at open on 10 Feb 2025 (speaker cites ~88; actual was ~86.7)
Nifty took support near 23300, the 50% Fibonacci retracement of the 22800-23800 pre-budget rally

lessons: Currency depreciation compounds FII losses and accelerates selling - watch the rupee at 9am for the day's tone.
quote: FIIs need a shock therapy; until then they will not stop selling.

summary: Rupee stabilized after RBI sold dollars; RBI doubles OMO purchases (fourth support 'installment': OMO, budget, rate cut, OMO increase). Aggressive call writing at 23400-23800 with fat premiums. Range 23200-23800 for the week; Sensex expiry today.

events.claim: RBI doubled open-market-operation purchases (announced ~10 Feb 2025)

lessons: Incremental policy support (OMOs, rate cuts) floors panic but rarely reverses a determined FII outflow.
quote: Small good things from the government become exit opportunities for FIIs.

summary: Nifty -400 intraday high-to-low, 5th straight fall; mid/small caps >20% off highs = bear market officially. 4th break of 23000 this year. Good results (Apollo) also sold; BHEL still 135 P/E after falling from 250 P/E - valuations sky-high. Averaging-down horror story; 2018 midcap mayhem parallel.

events.claim: By 11 Feb 2025 Nifty had fallen 5 consecutive sessions; first such streak of 2025
Midcap and smallcap indices down >20% from recent highs by mid-Feb 2025 (bear-market threshold)
Nifty closed lower for 4 consecutive months through January 2025 (speaker claim; Nov 2024 was slightly positive - likely inaccurate)
BHEL trading ~200 after peaking ~333-340; still ~135 P/E (had been ~250 P/E at peak)

lessons: High-growth-story stocks can stay expensive even after 30-40% falls; valuation, not drawdown, decides entry.
quote: Markets can remain irrational until you go bankrupt.

summary: Five straight falls; entire pre-budget 1000-pt rally wiped. Mid/small/nifty junior ~-20%. US data week (CPI today, PPI tomorrow, retail sales after). Results season ending 15 Feb. Broken support 23300 becomes resistance. HDFC/ICICI/Infosys ADRs green overnight.

events.claim: US January 2025 CPI released 12 Feb 2025; PPI 13 Feb; retail sales 14 Feb
Midcap/smallcap indices ~20% below recent highs with Nifty junior also ~-20% (12 Feb 2025)

lessons: Decisively broken support flips to resistance for the next leg - trade the flip, not the level's history.
quote: This midcap-smallcap pain is a 2018-style mayhem repeating after seven years.

summary: Broke 22800 again (full pre-budget rally erased); mid/small -10% in 3 sessions; then AMFI data (retail MF inflows ~40000 crore) triggered 350-pt short covering. Long-leg Doji close near 23000. Jan CPI 4.31% opens April-cut window; Direct Tax Code to be tabled tomorrow.

events.claim: India January 2025 CPI inflation came at 4.31% (released 12 Feb 2025), inside RBI's 2-6% band
Direct Tax Code (Income-tax Bill) to be tabled in Parliament 13 Feb 2025
Retail mutual-fund inflows ~40000 crore in January 2025 (~2000 crore/day DII firepower)
Nifty broke 22800 on 12 Feb 2025, erasing the entire pre-budget 1000-point rally

lessons: Brutal 3-session sellwaves historically exhaust themselves by day four - even in Lehman 2008 (speaker's observation).
quote: When brutal selling runs for three days, there is nothing left to sell on the fourth.

summary: US PPI better than expected; Nasdaq 100 fresh ATH while India faces 6th straight fall. DTC tabling day plus NRI foreign-asset declaration rumors. FII outflow math: ~4-5% USD return after tax+currency vs 5-5.5% tax-free Dubai deposits. Range 23000-23300 expected.

events.claim: Income-tax Bill (new Direct Tax Code) tabled in Parliament on 13 Feb 2025 with proposed NRI foreign-asset disclosure provisions
US January 2025 PPI came softer than expected (13 Feb 2025)

lessons: Post-tax, post-currency Indian equity returns (~4% USD) compete directly with tax-free foreign deposits - the structural case for FII outflows.
quote: Our returns in dollar terms are hardly 4 percent - why should FIIs take India's risk?

summary: 7th straight fall: broke 23000 intraday, +200 short covering, then classic 1:30-2pm FII selling. Kotak at 52-week high couldn't lift Bank Nifty. Mid/small green vs Nifty red. Map: 23300 = 50% Fib of post-budget fall; 22800 double bottom - break opens 22500. Every good news sold into (OMO, budget, RBI, Kotak).

events.claim: Nifty fell for the 7th consecutive trading session on 13 Feb 2025
Kotak Mahindra Bank hit a 52-week high around 13 Feb 2025
FIIs sold into every support measure: OMOs, budget, RBI cut, OMO increase (speaker pattern claim)

lessons: Late-afternoon (1:30-2pm) institutional selling marks the day's real intent; intraday bounces before it are noise.
quote: Every good news is getting sold into - that is really very bad.

summary: US PPI good, Nasdaq 100 ATH; India still falling. Structural tax math: 8-10% nominal return minus 3-4% currency minus 12.5% LTCG = ~4% USD return vs 5-5.5% tax-free abroad. Levels: 23300/23500/23800 resistances; 23000 then 22800 then 22500 supports. Suggests selling 22500 put / 23800 call range; no long-term positions.
lessons: Far-expiry, far-OTM option selling converts an unpredictable market into a range bet with defined risk.
quote: Until FII sentiment turns positive there is no reason to take long positions in midcaps.

summary: Triple bottom forms (~22725 vs prior 22775); 8th straight fall. Trump reciprocal-tariff remarks hit pharma (India's high import duties). India market cap cited below $4T, -18.5% from high in USD terms (speaker - likely overstated). Margin-trade funding ~78000 crore amplifies mid/small-cap falls - vicious cycle. 22500 = 50% Fib of 19000-26300 rise, next target.

events.claim: Trump signaled reciprocal tariffs against India's high import duties (~13-14 Feb 2025); pharma stocks sold off
Indian market capitalization fell below $4 trillion and ~18.5% from its dollar-terms high (speaker claim, likely overstated; actual ~$4.3T)
Margin trade funding outstanding ~78000 crore, amplifying midcap/smallcap falls
Nifty made a triple bottom near 22725 on 14 Feb 2025 after breaking the 22800 double-bottom zone

lessons: Leverage (MTF) creates the vicious cycle: the more a leveraged segment falls, the more forced selling it generates.
quote: Like Newton's law: a falling market keeps moving until an external force is applied.

summary: Range compressed 22800-23300; 23300 (50% Fib) uncrossable so far; double bottom 22800 broken so caution down. PM in US; more deported immigrants in handcuffs = negotiation pressure on tariffs. M&M EV bookings 30000+ day one - best auto stock; a two-wheeler major (name garbled) down ~30-35% from high. Advice: sell only far-month far-OTM options.

events.claim: M&M opened EV bookings with 30000+ reservations on day one (~14 Feb 2025)
PM Modi's US visit (12-13 Feb 2025) amid tariff negotiations; US sent another batch of deported Indian immigrants
A leading two-wheeler/auto stock corrected ~30-35% from its high (name garbled in transcript; possibly Bajaj Auto)

lessons: When short-term direction is unknowable, sell far-month far-OTM options where premiums are fat and prediction is unnecessary.
quote: Do not sell options in the current month; go one or two months away for safety.

summary: Ninth straight fall avoided only in the last 45 minutes (DIIs stepped in); low 22725 broke all prior bottoms. FM says FIIs are 'booking profits' (tax angle); finance secretary calls market 'resilient'. Singtel to sell ~$1B Bharti stake; FII -2900 crore, cumulative outflow since October crosses 3 lakh crore.

events.claim: FII cash selling since October 2024 crossed 3 lakh crore by 17 Feb 2025
Singtel announced sale of ~$1B of Bharti Airtel shares (~9% historical stake; ~0.8% sold in the block)
FM and finance secretary publicly called FII selling 'profit booking' and the market 'resilient' (~17 Feb 2025)
US markets closed 17 Feb 2025 for Presidents' Day

lessons: When officials publicly downplay outflows, watch whether DIIs defend the close - government-motivated support shows in the last hour.
quote: Whether you and me like this fall or not, the FM likes this fall.

summary: Tuesday Sensex expiry; volatility expected (last two Tuesdays swung +/-400). DIIs bought 1000 crore more than FIIs sold. India VIX now above US VIX - unusual. HDFC Bank 40-rupee intraday swings drive Bank Nifty 200-pt moves. Prefers far-dated short options (Dec 27000 call ~200; upper breakeven 27300). Time-correction thesis: price correction nearly done, 22500 possible, then sideways.

events.claim: BSE Sensex weekly expiry moved to Tuesdays (2025 change), concentrating volatility early-week
India VIX traded above the US VIX in mid-Feb 2025 (unusual, speaker claim)
Nifty December-2025(?) 27000 call trading ~200+ rupees giving upper breakeven ~27300

lessons: An index that repeatedly breaks its 'bottom' invalidates double-bottom logic - sell bounces only far OTM until lows stop breaking.
quote: After price correction comes time correction - markets may go nowhere for years.

summary: Fell again; 22800 broken a 4th time. Auto worst on Tesla hiring-in-India news; TCS broke 3900 (from ~4500) - defensive weakness. Bharti block deal (Singtel) hit the tape late. FII 'net buying' 4700 crore distorted by the block (~8000 crore buy side) - real flow still selling ~3000. 2019-style tax-cut surprise is the only fast fix, but unlikely near term.

events.claim: Tesla began hiring for India operations (~17-18 Feb 2025), pressuring Indian auto/EV stocks
TCS fell from ~4500 (Dec 2024) to below 3900 (18 Feb 2025)
FII daily flow of +4700 crore on 18 Feb 2025 was distorted by the Bharti Airtel block deal buy side (~8000 crore)

lessons: Block deals can flip a day's FII print; read gross flows around corporate actions before reading sentiment.
quote: One day she may remove LTCG and cut STCG - then Nifty crosses ATH within a week.
